title: Filter by a related node's field
notes: `country -> Country(iso = "CA")` in a condition keeps the airports whose country has that iso; XXX, with no country, is not among them (zega#86).

knownFailure.reason: zegadb/zega#86: the pinned engine (2b5ebd2) has no walk in a condition and no @count; this case records its outcome until the pin moves.
